title: A 232-Foot Rocket Booster Was Caught Out of the Sky by Two Arms

scenes.text: A 232-foot rocket booster was caught by two giant arms.
On October 13th, 2024, SpaceX launched its giant Starship rocket.
About seven minutes later, the Super Heavy booster flew back to the launch tower.
Instead of landing on legs, it dropped between two arms nicknamed chopsticks.
The booster is 232 feet tall and has 33 engines.
It was the first time a Super Heavy had ever been caught, like a ball in mid-air.

description:
On October 13th, 2024, SpaceX caught its 232-foot Super Heavy booster with the launch tower's arms, about seven minutes after liftoff.
It was the first time a Super Heavy booster had been caught.
Would you have bet on it?
first_comment: Would you have bet on the catch working the first time?
